<solution_file path="src/t02_load_eurostat.py">
import pandas as pd
import csv
import os

def main():
    # Read selected indicators
    selected_indicators_path = "outputs/t01_selected_indicators.csv"
    selected_df = pd.read_csv(selected_indicators_path)
    selected_indicator_ids = set(selected_df["indicator_id"].tolist())

    # Read raw Eurostat data
    raw_data_path = "inputs/eurostat/eurostat_city_values_sample.csv"
    raw_df = pd.read_csv(raw_data_path)

    # Filter to only selected indicators
    filtered_df = raw_df[raw_df["indicator_id"].isin(selected_indicator_ids)].copy()

    # Drop duplicates based on city_id, year, indicator_id
    filtered_df = filtered_df.drop_duplicates(subset=["city_id", "year", "indicator_id"])

    # Select and order columns for output
    output_columns = ["city_id", "city_name", "year", "indicator_id", "indicator_name", "value", "unit"]
    filtered_df = filtered_df[output_columns]

    # Write output CSV with RFC 4180 compliance
    output_path = "outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv"
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)

    with open(output_path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        writer = csv.writer(f, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL, lineterminator="\r\n")
        # Write header
        writer.writerow(output_columns)
        # Write data rows
        for _, row in filtered_df.iterrows():
            writer.writerow(row.tolist())

    print(f"Wrote {len(filtered_df)} rows to {output_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</solution_file>
